info.title: Mokly Cloud product API
info.description: Platform API with explicit 503 responses for deferred publication and review operations. Browser credentials land at /auth/email/callback, /auth/desktop/callback, /auth/github/callback or /auth/github/install; the /v1 callback operations below remain on the API origin. See the REST and authentication protocols. Screen selections use entry paths with the Mokly segment grammar.

post.summary: Plan a publication upload.
post.description: Streams one gzip plan archive holding the upload envelope, the export ownership marker and the catalogue index. Validates the declared catalogue, stores those artifacts, reserves every declared file and answers the file hashes this project still needs. A head already published for the same config answers an empty plan. See publication-upload-exchange.md for quotas and status compatibility.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Reserved; returns `validation-failed` until comments ship.

put.summary: Store one file the upload plan reported missing.
put.description: Sends one reserved file as raw application/octet-stream bytes or as a gzip body with Content-Encoding: gzip. Raw Content-Length must equal the reserved decoded size. A gzip Content-Length must not exceed that size. The server bounds decoding at the declared size plus one byte, verifies decoded size and SHA-256 before storage, and answers 400 without storing bytes for invalid gzip or a decoded mismatch. A file the project already stored answers 204 after draining the body. See publication-upload-exchange.md.

post.summary: Publish an upload whose files are all stored.
post.description: Takes an empty body. The attempt that became ready answers 201 on every completion; an attempt superseded by a ready publication of the same head and config answers 200 with that publication. Missing files answer 409 and an expired or closed attempt answers 410, after which the CLI plans again. See publication-upload-exchange.md.

200.description: Another upload of the same head and config is the ready publication.

Error.description:
The rpc-error envelope. `code` is one of rpc-error's fixed standard codes;
upload refusals use HTTP 426 for unsupported versions, 408 for request
deadlines and 410 for expired or closed attempts; `reason`
is this API's stable kebab-case identifier for the condition, catalogued in
docs/protocol/cloud/rest-api.md; `message` is client-safe; `request_id` correlates
server diagnostics. `error` is one closed variant per `data` type, keyed by
`reason`, and one variant without `data` for every other reason.

ErrorResponse.description: rpc-error envelope; the standard code fixes the status, except for the upload statuses that the Error schema names, and the reason names the condition. See the API conventions and rest-api.md.

SessionCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly mkc_session cookie with Path=/ and no Domain attribute. SameSite follows the current request's Origin on every exchange, rotation and clearing response. The public app origin receives SameSite=Lax; mokly-app://desktop receives SameSite=None when MKC_DESKTOP_CLIENT is true. Ordinary issuance uses Max-Age=2592000; desktop grant exchange and rotation use the time remaining until the inherited absolute deadline. Sign-out clears the cookie with Max-Age=0 and the same Origin rule. See docs/protocol/cloud/auth-sessions.md#sessions.

projectToken.description: Active project publishing token or live build-attempt upload grant; accepted only by the publication upload exchange.
